findings.evidence: `TensorProduct.lean:140-142` defines `tensorCoact` as `tensorCombine ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map coact coact`; `Comodule.lean:49-50` shows `Comodule` only needs `[Coalgebra R C]`, while Mathlib `Algebra/Algebra/Bilinear.lean:29-34` shows `LinearMap.mul'` only needs `[NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring C] [Module R C] [SMulCommClass R C C] [IsScalarTower R C C]`.
findings.fix: State these under the natural combined assumptions, e.g. `[AddCommMonoid C] [Module R C] [Coalgebra R C] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring C] [SMulCommClass R C C] [IsScalarTower R C C]`, with the existing comodule assumptions.
findings.issue: `tensorCoact`, `tensorCoact_def`, `tensorCoact_tmul`, and `tensorCoact_natural` require `[Semiring C] [Bialgebra R C]`, but the bodies only use `coact` and `tensorCombine`, not the bialgebra compatibility laws.

summary: The public tensor coaction API still assumes a full bialgebra where the definitions and naturality lemma only need a coalgebra coaction plus an R-bilinear multiplication on C.
